2014_spells.stoneskin.fullDescription: Using 1 action, this spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
